name: PocketmineMP Optix
author: info@swisscrafting.ch
description:
Pocketmine Egg
by onekintaro from swisscrafting.ch

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt-get update
apt-get install -y git curl wget jq file tar unzip zip

mkdir -p /mnt/server/
cd /mnt/server || exit 1

ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "x86_64" ]] && printf "amd64" || printf "arm64")

# Shouldn't be possible to be empty, but default to PM5 if it is and convert to uppercase
VERSION="${VERSION:-PM5}"
VERSION="${VERSION^^}"
UA="YuraCloud-Optix/1.0.0 (dapa@dapaproject.my.id)"

# Helper functions

download_php_binary() {
  VERSION_LOWER=$(echo "$VERSION" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
  printf "Downloading latest PHP %s binary for %s\n" "$REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION" "$VERSION"
  curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" --location --progress-bar "https://github.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/releases/download/${VERSION_LOWER}-php-${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}-latest/PHP-${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}-Linux-x86_64-${VERSION}.tar.gz" | tar -xzv
}

set_php_extension_dir() {
  printf "Configuring php.ini\n"
  EXTENSION_DIR=$(find "bin" -name '*debug-zts*')
  grep -q '^extension_dir' bin/php7/bin/php.ini && sed -i'bak' "s{^extension_dir=.*{extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"{" bin/php7/bin/php.ini || echo "extension_dir=\"$EXTENSION_DIR\"" >>bin/php7/bin/php.ini
}

download_pmmp() {
  DOWNLOAD_LINK=$(curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -sSL https://update.pmmp.io/api?channel="$API_CHANNEL" | jq -r '.download_url')
  printf "Downloading %s from %s\n" "$VERSION" "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
  curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" --location --progress-bar "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" --output PocketMine-MP.phar
}

# We have to convert VERSION into an API channel
if [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM4" ]]; then
  API_CHANNEL="4"
elif [[ "${VERSION}" == "PM5" ]]; then
   API_CHANNEL="stable"
else
  printf "Unsupported version: %s" "${VERSION}"
  exit 1
fi

REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION=$(curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" -sSL https://update.pmmp.io/api?channel="$API_CHANNEL" | jq -r '.php_version')

if [[ "${ARCH}" == "amd64" ]]; then
  download_php_binary
else
  apt install -y make autoconf automake m4 bzip2 bison g++ cmake pkg-config re2c libtool-bin
  
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/build_cache/archives
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/build_cache/compilation
  
  echo "running curl -H \"User-Agent: ${UA}\" --location --progress-bar --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/php/"$REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION"/compile.sh"
  curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" --location --progress-bar --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pmmp/PHP-Binaries/php/"$REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION"/compile.sh
  chmod +x compile.sh

  cat <<EOF
----------------------------------------
|                                      |
|   Compiling PHP Binary for ARM64     |
|                                      |
|  This is a time consuming process    |
----------------------------------------
EOF

  printf "\n\nCompiling PHP binary, this is a slow process and will take time\n"
  THREADS=$(grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo) || THREADS=1
  ./compile.sh -j "${THREADS}" -c /mnt/server/build_cache/archives -l /mnt/server/build_cache/compilation -P ${VERSION:2}
  rm compile.sh
  rm -rf install_data/
fi

download_pmmp
set_php_extension_dir || exit 1

if [[ ! -f server.properties ]]; then
  printf "Downloading default server.properties template\n"
  curl -H "User-Agent: ${UA}" --location --progress-bar --remote-name https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/game_eggs/minecraft/bedrock/pocketmine_mp/server.properties
fi

printf "Creating default file and folder structure\n"
touch banned-ips.txt banned-players.txt ops.txt white-list.txt server.log
mkdir -p players worlds plugins resource_packs

mkdir -p YuraCloud/data

if [ "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" = "auto" ] || [ -z "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" ]; then
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated"
elif echo "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" | grep -qE '([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'; then
	RESTART_TIME="${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}"
	RESTART_MODE="Admin-defined"
else
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated (invalid time)"
fi

echo "Server akan restart otomatis pada jam $RESTART_TIME WIB" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart.txt
echo "inactive" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart_status.txt
echo "[INSTALL] Auto-restart schedule: $RESTART_TIME WIB ($RESTART_MODE)" >> YuraCloud/data/restart.log

cat <<EOF
----------------------------------------
|                                      |
|   PocketMine-MP Installation Done    |
|                                      |
----------------------------------------
========================================
               YuraCloud                
========================================
UUID: ${P_SERVER_UUID:-Tidak Terdeteksi}
Port Server: ${SERVER_PORT:-Tidak Terdeteksi}
PocketMine Version: ${VERSION}
PHP Version: ${REQUIRED_PHP_VERSION}
========================================
 Auto-Restart   : Enabled
 Restart Time   : $RESTART_TIME WIB
 Restart Mode   : $RESTART_MODE
========================================
Terima kasih sudah membeli di yura cloud
========================================
EOF

variables.name: Auto-Restart Time
variables.description: Jadwal restart otomatis server (Format: HH:MM atau 'auto'). Contoh: 02:30 atau auto. Server akan restart otomatis pada jam ini setiap hari (WIB). Hanya admin yang bisa mengubah.
